questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Show that the centroid (the point 2 : 1 along a median from the vertex) of the triangle with vertices (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂), (x₃, y₃) is the average of the vertices.
questions.prompt_markup: Show that the centroid (the point 2 : 1 along a median from the vertex) of the triangle with vertices (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂), (x₃, y₃) is the average of the vertices.
questions.required_method: Partition the median from (x₁, y₁) to the midpoint of the opposite side in the ratio 2 : 1.
questions.grading_note: Any valid coordinate proof. Essential: midpoint ((x₂ + x₃)/2, (y₂ + y₃)/2); x₁ + ⅔((x₂ + x₃)/2 - x₁) = (x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3; the same for y.
